# Resonance

> Resonance is a free, independent Windows app that controls Sony headphones over Bluetooth, without a phone or an Android emulator. It is not made by or affiliated with Sony. Sony publishes its own app, Sound Connect (formerly Headphones Connect), for Android and iPhone only.

Latest version: 1.2.0 (November 2026). Runs on Windows 10 (1809) or later and Windows 11. Available in English and French. Free for personal and other noncommercial use under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0; the source code is public.

## Features

- Noise cancelling, ambient sound with level and voice focus, off
- Equalizer presets and custom curves, with the bands the model offers
- Battery of each earbud, the case or the headband
- Global keyboard shortcuts for noise modes
- Touch control presets, gestures, quick access and head gestures
- Multipoint device switching and playback pinning
- DSEE Extreme, connection priority, background music, voice boost, live sound level
- Quick settings from the notification area icon, and a command line (resonance-cli)

It does not update firmware; that still needs Sony's phone app.

## Supported headphones

- Every setting tested on the device: WF-1000XM6
- Checked against recorded sessions, changing settings not yet confirmed by an owner: WF-1000XM5, LinkBuds Clip, WH-1000XM3
- Same protocols, should work, not confirmed yet: WH-1000XM4, WH-1000XM5, WH-1000XM6, WF-1000XM4, WF-C700N, other LinkBuds
